On Saturday, September 28, 2024, 8,490 Equity Shares were debited from the demat account (maintained with NSDL) of Bharti Airtel Employees' Welfare Trust (ESOP Trust) of the Company towards the exercise of ESOPs by eligible employees, however, since the transfer of equity shares is settled on T+1 basis as per the process of depository, such shares were credited into demat accounts of ESOP allottees (maintained with CDSL) post closure of quarter ended on September 30, 2024 (i.e. on October 01, 2024). Accordingly, such shares, being under settlement process of depository, were neither in NSDL account of ESOP Trust nor in the CDSL account of employees as on September 30, 2024. Therefore, in order to reflect the factual position of equity share capital of the Company, the abovementioned 8,490 equity shares have been included in the category Resident Individuals holding nominal share capital upto Rs. 2 lakhs as the shares were already debited to get credited in CDSL account of employees.   The  records may be reflecting the no. of shares held in dematerialized form under this category as 84,855,305, which can be arrived after excluding 8,490 equity shares from 84,863,795 equity shares reported in the category Resident Individuals holding nominal share capital upto Rs. 2 lakhs.
